description.fun: Stunfisk is a flat fish that buries itself in the mud of the seashore and waits; when prey touches it, it delivers a jolt, and for some reason it smiles slightly while doing so. Its skin is so tough it's unhurt even if a sumo wrestler steps on it. It owes its electric organs to bacteria that lived with it in the mudflats. Mana Ibe designed it out of a wish to make the flattest Pokémon ever.
description.guide: Stunfisk is a Ground- and Electric-type flatfish Pokémon that hides in seashore mud and shocks prey that touch it. In Galar it has a Ground- and Steel-type regional form. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: A flat, grinning fish that zaps whoever steps on it.

description.fun: Living in Galar's iron-rich mud gave it a steel body, and it can no longer make electricity. Instead it lies in wait with its Poké Ball-like lips showing, and when prey comes close it clamps its jagged steel fins shut like a bear trap. Its leaf-like markings may help it blend in.
